name: TradeInAppraisalWorkbench
tagline: Grade, price and offer on every trade-in – with an ACV you can explain.
description: A complete trade-in appraisal app for car dealers in one Power Apps component: condition grading, priced damage lines, mileage-adjusted market comparables, a transparent ACV waterfall, offers with expiry and manager approval for over-allowances, and look-to-book KPIs. Works with demo data the moment it is dropped on a canvas screen, a model-driven form or a Power Pages page.
features: ACV waterfall (target gross, pack, holding cost)
Over-allowance approval with tolerance and appraiser limit
Offer expiry, extension and lapsed-offer handling
Equity, gap to ask and expected gross
Drag-and-drop status board with business rules
Low-code column mapping and Power Fx events
controlType: standard (2 controls: data-set + Power Pages field)
